text:
Asha: quick check — I'm reworking the batch vectors preview + export flow. want to confirm a few small UX/copy/accessibility things before i push comps.
Tom: thanks — can you list the specific pain points?
Asha: main ones: 1) export CSV feels ambiguous (are we exporting source rows, vectors, or both?) 2) preview density toggle is unclear (compact vs full) 3) keyboard focus on the relevance score column is getting lost when you open the row inspector 4) aria labels for the sample selector absent.
Evan: agree on #1 — saw a support ticket where a customer expected only text rows and got 1536-d vectors in the file and panicked :grimacing:
Jules: for copy, what about "Include numeric vectors (embeddings) in export" instead of "Export vectors"? a bit more explicit.
Asha: good. draft copy options i have: "Export rows only", "Export rows + vectors (numeric)" and a helper tooltip: "Vectors are large numeric arrays — include only if you need raw embeddings."
Marta: +1 for explicit. also add an estimated file size note when vectors are included — customers underestimate size.
Asha: mockup shows "Estimated size: ~120MB" under the checkbox when selected. is that ok?
Tom: yes. small nit: make it accessible — use `aria-live` for the estimation update so screenreader users get it when they toggle.
aria-bot: accessibility suggestion — use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for non-interruptive updates.
Asha: perfect, i'll add that.
Evan: about preview density — users confused between "compact" and "full". can we rename to "Condensed" and "Expanded"? or use icons?
Jules: Condensed/Expanded better — less jargon than density. Also suggest a tooltip: "Condensed shows one row per input; Expanded shows vectors + metadata inline."
Marta: another accessibility nit: contrast on the relevance color gradient is borderline at 14px. we need to ensure WCAG AA for text or move the color to an icon only.
Tom: proposal: keep gradient for the background of a 10px pill, but include the numeric score as text with a sufficient contrast color on top. if color fails, fallback to a chevron + label.
Asha: noted. also keyboard flow issue: when you arrow down the table and press Enter to open a row inspector, focus should land on the first tabbable control inside the inspector (copy vector button). currently it lands on the inspector header and tab goes to body — causes extra tabbing.
Evan: that was my prototype bug — i can set `focus()` on mount to the first button. will do.
Jules: copy tweaks for the inspector header: replace "Vectors" title with "Input vectors & relevance" so it's clearer why a user opened it.
Asha: sounds good.
Marta: export modal accessibility: the download link should have `download` attribute and an explicit filename like `projectname_vectors_2025-08-13.csv` so screenreaders announce it's a file.
Tom: also include a small keyboard shortcut hint in the modal footer: "Press D to start download" (with tooltip that it can be disabled in settings). ensure the hint isn't the only mechanism to trigger download for discoverability.
Asha: UX question: do we default to excluding vectors for exports? my sense is yes (opt-in) to avoid surprise large downloads.
Evan: default exclude vectors. add a small "Include vectors" toggle with a confirmation when file > 50MB: "This export will be large. Continue?"
Jules: for rerank table: users asked for a persistent sort-by-score toggle so they can default to "Sort by relevance" when they open the table. maybe a per-user preference saved in local prefs.
Marta: can that be stored in the workspace settings instead? bigger teams will want consistent behavior.
Tom: store it in workspace settings with a fallback to local if user has no workspace override. simple flag: `defaultSort: 'relevance' | 'time'`.
Asha: great. last thing — tiny code suggestion for aria label on the sample selector dropdown (the one that chooses sampling size):
Asha: ```html
<select aria-label="Number of preview samples" id="preview-sample-size">
  <option value="10">10 samples</option>
  <option value="50">50 samples</option>
</select>
```
Evan: looks good. also add `aria-describedby` pointing to a short hint for larger counts (performance).
aria-bot: contrast check passed for primary buttons. recommended CSS tweak for the light gray helper text: `color: #6B7280` -> `#374151` to meet AA at 14px.
Asha: thanks bot. i'll update comps and push a new figma link in this thread.
Jules: sgtm — want a quick design review at 2pm?
Tom: i can make 2pm. Evan?
Evan: free.
Marta: i'll join for the accessibility pass.
Asha: awesome — i'll drop the updated figma + export modal prototype at 1950001280 and tag you all.
aria-bot: deploy note: staging deploy of table changes succeeded — release/preview-embeds-ux @ 1950001275
Tom: thanks — will review the staging build after your figma.
Asha: updated figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/vectors-export-ux — includes state for large export warning + aria notes.
Jules: looks really clean. small copy nit: change helper from "Vectors are large numeric arrays" to "Vectors are numeric arrays; including them increases file size significantly."
Asha: updated copy and pushed to figma. anyone else?
Marta: all good from a11y POV once the contrast and aria-live are implemented.
Evan: i'll fix the focus-on-open bug and add `aria-describedby` hints.
Tom: i'll handle persistence for default sort and the estimated size calculation.
Asha: thanks team — will merge protos into the `/design/embeds-export` branch after review. :sparkles:
